_comment: Generic global-auth config. Set enabled=true to log in ONCE before the suite and reuse the session via storageState (skips per-test login). Expressions are Playwright locator expressions referencing `page`; credentials are read from the named .env vars. Disabled by default so features with their own per-test login (e.g. EnergyAuditorAuthentication) keep working unchanged. Enabled here for DeliveryInsights (SCF-2335), whose pages require an authenticated Backoffice session — the multi-step (email -> Next -> password) form and post-login club switch mirror scripts/auto_locator_extractor.js's login flow.
